name: Ihor Lazarkov

about_me.summary: Senior SDET with 18 years designing and scaling test automation across financial, telecom, and SaaS organizations — from frameworks adopted across entire client engagements to test architectures rolled out team-wide. Pursuing the next step into a dedicated Test/Automation Architect role, backed by hands-on full-stack and AI-tooling experience.

notable_accomplishments: Served as client-facing technical lead at Edward Jones, achieving a 95% satisfaction rate from business partners.
Architected a POC automation tool at Edward Jones (Java, JavaEE, Spring Boot, Hibernate) that became the foundation of the team's automation framework.
Redesigned Edward Jones' legacy automation framework with custom adapters for DB/EMS message validation — **60% faster execution**, **50% more reliable**.
Designed and rolled out a new test automation architecture at Comcast within the first two weeks — **60% faster execution**, adopted by a team of 20 engineers.
Diagnosed an inverted test pyramid at Comcast that was inflating defects and slowing delivery; findings were adopted into the engineering roadmap.
Designed a cross-project automation framework at EPAM used to validate databases and messages across all client projects — **4x faster test execution**.
Prevented several critical defects from reaching production at Cisco Meraki by establishing quality gates, protecting the company's reputation.

experience.title: SDET IV
experience.description: Contribute in automation testing with high-quality code and testing insides to project management during crucial for company time of migration of current CRM to future proprietary one.
contributions: Designed and implemented a new test automation architecture within the first two weeks, reducing test execution time by up to 60%, then trained a team of 20 engineers to adopt it across their projects
Developed and maintained an AI engineering harness (skills, context management, sub-agents), enabling AI to generate up to 90% of code while I retained review and architectural oversight.

Assessed the existing automation framework and application codebase — architecture, design, and unit/component test coverage — identifying an inverted test pyramid with excessive E2E coverage and root-causing multiple defects, including a race condition surfaced during automated test entry; findings quantified the cost to the business and were adopted into the team's roadmap, with remediation scheduled following the current release.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, Testing
experience.description: Worked as Senior Software Engineer in Test in a team of 6 engineers. Responsible for delivering software for automation testing of functional and integration tests with following integration into CI/CD. Communication with product ownership to learn functionality, demo of completed work, gather feedback and deliver improvements.
contributions: Served as client-facing technical lead for the automation framework: negotiated testing requirements directly with stakeholders, and presented test coverage and release-readiness reports to leadership — driving framework design decisions without formal direct reports, and achieving a 95% satisfaction rate from business partners.
Architected, designed and implemented a POC automation tool using Java Core, JavaEE, Spring Boot, and Hibernate for ELT testing, laying the foundation for the team's future automation framework.

Drastically improved a legacy automation framework for a distributed-services application by designing and implementing adapters to validate database state persistence and EMS messages, resulting in a 60% decrease in automation execution time and a 50% reliability improvement.
Improved performance in existing and new automation test cases by up to 60%.
Supported engineers in troubleshooting technical issues and coached the team on best practices for handling failed assertions and fallbacks to keep test data idempotent.
Implemented POC that served as base for other team to build project with reusable API as library
Identified and fixed false positive tests

Contributed to software for automation testing with development of architectural solutions and best practices by utilization of OOP principles (e.g., polymorphism, inheritance, encapsulation) programming design patterns (e.g., Builder, Singleton, Factory, Commander or Strategy, Facade) and decoupling implementation and encapsulation via abstract methods, interfaces and functional interfaces.

Meticulous code analysis of transitioned project by debugging, executing of tests, gaining ownership of a code-base, refactoring and as a result stability improvements, decrease of duplicated code by ~1800 lines and tests execution time by up to 40%.

Developed reliable software for automation testing of Web-pages and solved high-complex problems by thorough analysis of HTML, CSS and JavaScript via effective use of Dev-tools to identify mechanism of functioning of components of the page.

Design test scenarios in Gherkin language using parametrizable instructions, DataTables, Scenario Outline for reusability with maximum level of readability for non-technical people as well as with exhaustive level of details to make test valuable assets and source of truth.

Development of glue code (executable code associated with each command in feature file) and organizing it in clear per web page and/or per functionality manner to establish clear ownership and responsibilities to avoid code duplication and improve maintenance.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Part-Time)
experience.description: Worked part-time as a Software Engineer, concurrent with full-time role at Edward Jones, in an agile environment with 2 more engineers to design and implement SaaS for marketing.
contributions: Provide functionality with close to 0 (zero) return rate by applying best practices in software design
Develop convenient tests harness on unit, integration and systems levels that brings high level of confidence in software

Implement re-usable complex (e.g., accordion, filterable lists, tabs) components using JSX, parametrization via variables or data in JSON, React hooks (e.g., useState, useRef, useContext, useReducer) with respective styling via CSS file and in-line style attribute.
Debug and bugfix of 10+ of issues, perform root-cause analyze using dev tools (e.g., DevTools, React-Devtools).

experience.title: Software Engineer (open-source contributor), Front End
experience.description: Worked as a Software Engineer in an open-source project with an international team of contributors. The project provides standardized components for Layer5 projects.
contributions: Gained expertise in existing JSX, TSX, CSS codebase by analyzing requirements, unit tests, codebases to become domain knowledge expert.

Implement functionalities applying well-fit data-structures (e.g., map, list, set), architecture (using interfaces, types, OOP principles), design patterns (e.g., Singleton, Builder, Commander, Factory) that provide a maintainable and scalable codebase.
Analyze existing codebase (presence of media queries, aria-label attributes etc) to audit its adherence to responsive web design and accessibility practice.
Debug new and existing issues, code analyze resulting in gain of knowledge in project architecture (classes, interfaces etc.).
Bug fix by implementing clean and documented code utilizing declared types, interfaces, enums.
Managed code contributions via Git, regularly merging updates and submitting well-documented pull requests.
Participate in community meetings, attentively listen to changes being introduced by others and present completed work.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, Testing
experience.description: Worked as Senior Software Engineer in Test, and software test engineer in a team of 5. Developed software for functional, E2E and API testing using in-house and new automation test frameworks. Completed test planning and test design. Established testing standards and processes.
contributions: Successfully accomplished thorough testing of an application during pivotal change of the business model of the company by developing and execution of a test plan that consisted of multiple phases to accommodate and deliver KPIs.
Developed software from scratch for functional and integration testing of front-end and back-end.
Integration of seamless automation testing into CI/CD with reactive reporting to Slack.

Defined, together with the team, and developed quality gates for the functional changes that drastically improved stability of builds and prevented several critical defects of being promoted to production which saved the company’s reputation and improved productivity of teams what would switch for bug fix otherwise.
Effective communication with team members by defining a clear agenda, questions and timeframe for meetings.

experience.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer
experience.description: Worked in a fast-paced, agile environment on multiple complex projects, with multiple teams of 5 employees each. Developed test standards and strategies for new releases, defined the scope of testing, and collaborated with technical teams and product owners to discuss functional details. Designed and executed Java-based automation testing and performance tests frameworks and tools such as Selenium WD, Cucumber, FitNesse, TestNG, Rest Assured and JMeter etc. for web applications and RESTful application programming interface (API) services.
contributions: Leveraged technical expertise to design an automation test framework to validate databases and messages across all projects and tests for a client, resulting in 4-times faster test execution, decreased support time, and improved visibility of software quality using proficient programming skills, expertise in Java, programming design patterns.

Expanded testing coverage and capabilities by introducing new automation testing technology and transitioning away from the legacy system, which enabled cleaner tests and optimized readability, maintenance, and enhancements.

Led a decrease in regression execution time and enabled monitoring of software stability by implementing a necessary code base and new Gradle tasks to enhance reliability and integration of automation test frameworks into CI/CD processes.

Delivered reliable and scalable software by designing and integrating a new software project from scratch, including web applications, automation test frameworks, libraries, and plugins, to test front-end, back-end, and RESTful APIs. Utilized Cucumber, Selenium, REST Assured, and numerous best practices, including configurability, reusability of components, object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts, Java design patterns, and functional programming.

Decreased the time required for test preparation, test investigation, and QA environment health monitoring by developing web applications to facilitate testing using Spring Boot MVC, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

testimonial.author: Sonum Matur
testimonial.title: Software Engineering Manager @ Cisco Meraki
testimonial.content: Ihor is a very sincere and dedicated SDET Engineer. His clarity and concepts of test automation to cover the quality of the product was impressive. He preached the test automation pyramid while we worked together at Meraki and was also instrumental in right execution for the product quality. Ihor is a quick and ambitious learner and always wanted to explore more and more of knowledge and skill set.

testimonial.author: Venkat Gunji
testimonial.title: Founder & CEO of LVC Solutions
testimonial.content: I had the pleasure of working with Ihor and was consistently impressed by his technical expertise, professionalism, and collaborative approach. He brings strong problem-solving skills, a deep understanding of software development, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results. Ihor is someone who takes ownership of his work, communicates effectively, and is always willing to support the team when needed. His ability to tackle complex challenges and turn ideas into practical solutions makes him a valuable asset to any organization. Beyond his technical skills, Ihor is a great team player who fosters a positive and productive working environment. I highly recommend him to any company looking for a skilled, reliable, and dedicated engineering professional.
